messages:
Mike H: Heads-up — final cutoff for v2.8.0 patch release in 90m. Need one last pass: annotated tag, artifacts uploaded to S3, and draft GitHub release.
Sara L: On changelog — I pulled in the small fixes PRs. Can reviewers confirm there's no user-facing regressions? @Jordan P
Jordan P: Quick skim OK. Noticed a minor doc typo in #3245 but not release-blocking.
Alex R: I'll do the version bump PR and push the tag after CI passes. Reminder: use annotated tag format with build metadata.
Mike H: Tagging snippet we use:
```
git tag -a v2.8.0-rc1 -m "v2.8.0 (patch) - annotated"
git push origin v2.8.0-rc1
```
Also we require the release notes file uploaded as artifacts (release-notes-v2.8.0.md) and the linux wheel and tarball with checksums.
Sara L: Uploads should go to s3://redwood-releases/2.8.0/ with filenames:
- redwood-2.8.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
- redwood-2.8.0-py3.whl
- redwood-2.8.0-checksums.txt
Jordan P: CI Bot, can you confirm artifact promotion once tests pass?
CI Bot: Tests green on main-build-2.8.0 (job #412). Artifacts archived: /artifacts/412/
Release Bot: Reminder: Draft release template created at /releases/drafts/v2.8.0-draft.md — remember to paste final changelog and mark as prerelease=false.
Alex R: I'll run the release cli once the tag is pushed. Command I use:
```
gh release create v2.8.0 \\
  --notes-file release-notes-v2.8.0.md \\
  --target main \\
  --draft \\
  --title \"v2.8.0\"
```
Mike H: For annotated tag vs lightweight tag — prefer annotated so GitHub picks up the message. Also include the commit SHA in the release description.
Sara L: I can finish the changelog and add PR links. Ping me when the tag exists.
Jordan P: Quick QA: confirm that the package build uses the same PyPI metadata as last release. Alex, can you ensure the wheel build step uses --no-build-isolation? (last time packaging changed)
Alex R: Yep, will keep the same build flags. Will push the version bump PR in 10m.
Mike H: If anyone can't make the cutoff, say so now. Otherwise I'll coordinate the publish at cutoff+15m.
Sara L: I'm available for post-publish verification.
Jordan P: Out of office after 30m but can do smoke tests before I go :thumbsup:
Alex R: Tag pushed: v2.8.0 (annotated). PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4556
Mike H: Saw it. Alex, please run the release CLI but do NOT press publish — leave as draft until I paste final notes.
Alex R: Done — draft created and artifacts attached. Release link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v2.8.0
Mike H: Perfect. I'll paste final changelog and flip publish in 10.
Sara L: Thanks all. :rocket:
